QUOTE: "Every front end therefore asks which languages are compiled in ... The gate prevents that by resolving the route to no grammar." and "The not-indexed report ... stamps at build time which in-scope file types have no rows."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says that an installation lacking the grammars doesn't crash. A capability gate resolves the route to no grammar, and the missing file types are then reported as not indexed.
